name: tessera
description: Rooms to read in. Sixteen themes for the Claude Code desktop app, each one still while you read.

plugins.name: tessera
plugins.description: Tessera: all 25 themes in one plugin. Type /tessera and a name to change the room.

plugins.name: cinis
plugins.description: Cinis (ash). A plain graphite page with a faint lift of light in one corner.

plugins.name: purpura
plugins.description: Purpura (purple). Velvet curtains at the edges of a dark violet stage, with bright glints in the folds.

plugins.name: indicum
plugins.description: Indicum (indigo). A far city at 2am, flat blocks of towers low in the corners of a deep indigo page.

plugins.name: terra
plugins.description: Terra (earth). Flat bands of brick, mustard, moss, teal and plum sweep out of two corners of a warm page.

plugins.name: dulcis
plugins.description: Dulcis (sweet). Candy colored confetti in the corners of a warm dark page.

plugins.name: glacies
plugins.description: Glacies (ice). Flat planes of cut ice stacked in two corners of a cool grey page.

plugins.name: sol
plugins.description: Sol (sun). A sundial drawn in fine lines, with a slow shadow crossing the hours.

plugins.name: malva
plugins.description: Malva (mallow). A cafe table from above, with a cup of milky coffee in one corner and a folded napkin in the other.

plugins.name: atramentum
plugins.description: Atramentum (ink). Black ink on white newsprint, with halftone dots in two corners.

plugins.name: fulgur
plugins.description: Fulgur (lightning). Neon circuit traces along the edges of a near black screen.

plugins.name: caementum
plugins.description: Caementum (concrete). Heavy concrete slabs stacked at the edges, with one small red square.

plugins.name: forma
plugins.description: Forma (form). Flat circles, squares and triangles in red, blue and yellow, set in two corners of a warm white page.

plugins.name: phosphor
plugins.description: Phosphor (light-bringer). The soft glow of an old green screen, and the paper it printed on.

plugins.name: machina
plugins.description: Machina (machine). An engineer's blueprint, with gears and a compass rose drawn in the corners.

plugins.name: aurum
plugins.description: Aurum (gold). Gold fans and sunbursts in the corners of a warm black room.

plugins.name: pluvia
plugins.description: Pluvia (rain). Rain on a window, and a lit city through the glass.

plugins.name: aurora
plugins.description: Aurora (dawn). Northern lights over a snowy ridge on a long polar night.

plugins.name: abyssus
plugins.description: Abyssus (the deep). Deep blue water, with jellyfish glowing softly at the edges.

plugins.name: nox
plugins.description: Nox (night). A clear night sky over low hills, with stars gathered at the edges.

plugins.name: vesper
plugins.description: Vesper (evening). The last light of evening over a wide plain, with a sun half set at the edge.

plugins.name: ignis
plugins.description: Ignis (fire). A hearth at night, with embers glowing low in the corners and sparks rising at the edges.

plugins.name: silva
plugins.description: Silva (forest). Pine woods in mist, with fireflies at the edges of the trees.

plugins.name: scriptorium
plugins.description: Scriptorium (writing room). A vellum page with painted vines in its margins, and a candle burning low at night.

plugins.name: hortus
plugins.description: Hortus (garden). A greenhouse in soft daylight, with broad leaves reaching in from the edges.

plugins.name: flos
plugins.description: Flos (flower). A flowering branch in spring, reaching in from the corner.
